content: Hessafe guye, taani salo xeelliya wode dooyetida penge be7as. Qassi ta kase si7ida moyze girsaa melay taako, “Ha keya; haysafe guye, hananaw de7iyaba ta nena bessaana” yaagis.
He wode ta Ayyaanan haaretada de7ayis. Heko, saluwan araata bolla issoy uttidaysa be7as.
He uttidaysa malay yasphedenne sardiyoone al7o shucha mela. Iya araata yuushuwan al7o margide shuchi daaniya zuulli de7ees.
He araata yuushuwan laatamanne oyddu araatati de7oosona; enta bolla bootha ma7o ma7idi, huuphen worqa kallachaa wothida laatamanne oyddu cimati uttidosona.
Araatape wol7anthi, guunthinne deshoy keyees. Araata sinthan laapun poo7iya xompeti de7oosona; enti laapun Xoossaa ayyaanata.
Araata sinthan birille daaniya phooliya burcuko abbay de7ees. Sintharanne guyera ayfey de7iya oyddu de7ora de7iya medhetethati araata yuushuwaninne araata giddon de7oosona.
Koyro medhetetha medhoy gaammo daanees; nam7anthoy boori daanees; heedzanthoy ase daanees; qassi oyddanthoy piradhiya arganthi daanees.

Oyddu medhetethata ubbaas usupun qefey de7ees; enta asatethaa ubbay ayfen kumis. Enti qammanne gallas qanxonna, “Geeshshaw, geeshshaw, geeshshaw, Godaw, Ubbaafe Wolqaama Xoossaw, Kaseka, ha77ika de7eyso, sinthafe yaanayso” yaagosona.
He medhetethati araatan uttidaysasinne merinaw de7eysas saba, bonchonne galata immida wode,
laatamanne oyddu cimati araatan uttidaysanne merinaw de7eysa sinthan gufannidi goyinnidosona; banta kallachaa araata sinthan wothidi,

content.text: neeni boncho, sabanne wolqaa ekanaw bessaasa.
